subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: Should this issue remain the canonical broad live-repro tracker for multi-session Gateway stalls until current-main proof isolates the remaining bottleneck?
rationale: Partial fixes exist, but the central live workload has not been replayed after those fixes and related narrower session/compaction issues remain open, so automation cannot safely decide whether to close, split, or continue tracking this broad report.

options.title: Keep As Broad Live-Repro Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or QA run captures current-main/latest-release latency for logs.tail, chat.history, sessions.list, sessions.compact, Gateway status/stability, and channel delivery under a large session store.

options.title: Split Remaining Surfaces
options.body: If maintainers can identify one dominant remaining bottleneck, move that work to narrower issues while preserving this issue as the linked umbrella context.

options.title: Close After Live Replay Passes
options.body: Close only if a current-main or latest-release replay shows Gateway RPC and channel delivery stay responsive under a comparable large multi-agent workload.

recommendation.title: Keep As Broad Live-Repro Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or QA run captures current-main/latest-release latency for logs.tail, chat.history, sessions.list, sessions.compact, Gateway status/stability, and channel delivery under a large session store.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue already routed follow-up attention to vincentkoc and the remaining decision is broad Gateway/session liveness scoping rather than one merged partial-fix author’s narrow path.
